dct_description_sm: The underwater soundscape is an extremely important feature of the marine ecosystem, and ambient noise is an important feature of the underwater soundscape. Ambient noise is the background noise against which signals are discerned; when heightened, it can affect an animals ability to detect and interpret signals. Ambient noise levels have been reported in various locations in the Arctic, but have yet to be reported in Baffin Bay. With expected increases in anthropogenic noise due to accelerated industrial pressures, increased oil and gas exploration, expansion of fisheries, and increased shipping through the northwest passage there is a pressing need to document baseline ambient noise levels in this region. This data was collected to assess baseline ambient noise levels along the coast of Baffin Island and to determine the seasonal presence of marine mammals including narwhal and bowhead.
dct_title_s: Acoustic monitoring along the East coast of Baffin Island (2014-2019)
